summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FeGrro bug fixes. All 3 critical bugs fixed and verified: 1) Admin can edit hours for any date (not just today/yesterday), 2) UUID key parsing works correctly, 3) Assignment deduplication removes conflicting dates. All frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin login with admin@fegrro.pl / Admin123! works
Backend: BUG FIX 1 - POST /hours allows admins to set hours for any date (tested with 2026-04-01)
Backend: BUG FIX 2 - Hours saved/retrieved correctly for UUID employee IDs
Backend: BUG FIX 3 - Assignment deduplication removes overlapping dates from old assignments
Backend: Polish month variants (KWIECIEŃ and KWIETNIA) both work in queries
Backend: Hours update existing entries correctly
Backend: Site totals calculated correctly based on assignments
Frontend: Admin can access hours table at /admin/hours-table
Frontend: BUG FIX - Clicking cell in edit mode opens number input
Frontend: BUG FIX - Typing hours and pressing Enter saves successfully (toast 'Godziny zapisane')
Frontend: BUG FIX - Hours appear in cell after saving (tested: changed 6 to 7)
Frontend: BUG FIX - Site totals update correctly after saving (SASINO: 37→38, SUMA: 37→38)
Frontend: BUG FIX - Selecting site, clicking cells, clicking 'Przypisz' assigns successfully
Frontend: BUG FIX - After assignment, cells show assigned site's color (ŁEBA ERBUD = rgb(74, 90, 65))
Frontend: SUMA column shows correct total of all hours
Frontend: Nieprzypisane column shows hours not assigned to any site
Frontend: Name column has neutral dark background (#1E293B = rgb(30, 41, 59))
Frontend: Weekend columns visually distinct with reddish-brown background (#3D2E2E)

test_credentials.workers: Jan Kowalski, Anna Nowak, Piotr Wiśniewski, Test Employee

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 critical bugs have been fixed and verified: 1) Backend POST /hours now allows admins to set hours for any date (role check added), 2) Frontend key parsing fixed - date is last 10 chars, employee ID is rest (handles UUIDs with dashes), 3) Backend POST /assignments deduplicates by removing assigned dates from other assignments for same employee/month. Polish month variants (KWIECIEŃ/KWIETNIA) work in GET /assignments. Test data: Jan Kowalski has hours on days 1(7h), 8(8h), 10(7h), 15(8h), 20(8h) with SASINO assignment, and days 22-24 assigned to ŁEBA ERBUD.
